artworks.title: Mercury Entering Herse's Room after Changing Agraulos to Stone
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltizus, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a classical mythological scene in an interior with intricate details. The composition features a reclining nude figure on lavish fabrics under a canopy. A standing figure on the left holds a staff entwined with snakes. In the background, a seated figure interacts with another cloaked figure against a backdrop of columns and paneling. An overflowing urn of flowers is in the foreground, next to a small dog on the floor. The artwork shows detailed line work and a sense of spatial depth, highlighting the interiors and narrative.

artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a sketch on a textured, brown background. The figure on the left is depicted from the waist up, leaning forward on one knee with one hand on the ground. This figure has wavy hair and is wearing a flowing garment. The second figure on the right is shown in full, standing with a dynamic posture. This figure appears to have wings and is holding a long staff. Both figures are sketched with delicate lines and shading against a minimal background.

artworks.title: A Branch of Gooseberries with a Dragonfly, an Orange-Tip Butterfly, and a Caterpillar
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on prepared paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a thorny branch with round berries and small green leaves. The berries range from pale green to yellow to rich reddish-brown, with thin pale veins running through them. A butterfly, a caterpillar, and a dragonfly are also present, resting on the leaves. The butterfly's wings are pale orange and the dragonfly is blue, while the caterpillar is covered in thin white fibers. The background is solid black.

artworks.title: Anne Ward Morland (Delia in Town)
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after George Morland
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving inked à la poupée on chine collé [proof before inscription]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated from the waist up. She is facing forward with a slight angle to the side. Her facial expression is neutral, and she has curly hair that falls to her shoulders. She wears a light-colored dress with long sleeves and a sash tied around her waist. She is wearing a large purple hat adorned with feathers. Her hands are clasped together on a wooden table. The background includes a window showing a tree outside and a simple chair with a blue cushion inside.

artworks.title: Anne Ward Morland
artworks.medium: graphite with black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a seated woman from the waist up. She is facing sideways, leaning against a table or surface with her hands clasped in front of her. She has delicate facial features, light expression, and curly brown hair flowing over her shoulders. The woman wears a high-necked dress with puffed sleeves and a large hat adorned with plumes. In the background, there is a faint sketch of a tree visible through a window.

artworks.title: The Animal Laocöon
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a lion and other animals in a dramatic scene. The lion is in a struggle with a large snake, surrounded by other animals. The background includes a rocky cave and foliage. The artwork focuses on intricate details and textures, highlighting the intensity of the confrontation.

artworks.title: An Oak Forest with a Family of Travelers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland pond surrounded by dense trees and foliage. The intricate etching style depicts detailed textures of tree bark and leaves, creating a sense of depth. The color palette is monochrome with shades of sepia or dark brown on a light background. Two figures and a dog are wading into the water, and a waterfall can be seen in the distance, framed by lush trees with spreading branches.

artworks.title: Cathédrale de Chartres - Portique du Midi XIIe Siècle
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: The Sarah and William L Walton Fund
artworks.description: The image shows intricately sculptured figures as part of the facade of a grand architectural structure. The figures are carved into the stone building, positioned between pointed arches. The sculptures depict human forms standing within ornate columns framing the entrance portals. The figures appear to be wearing robes and show detailed craftsmanship. The stone material is weathered gray. The facade is viewed head-on with the figures slightly above eye level, reached by stone steps leading to the entryway. The setting suggests a historical and monumental context, surrounded by other buildings and trees, giving the impression of a significant historical site.

artworks.title: Foxgloves
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image features tall, flowering foxgloves with bell-shaped blooms in the foreground, set against a background of leafy foliage. The color palette is in sepia tones. The foxgloves rise towards the upper part of the image, surrounded by spreading leaves. In the background, detailed foliage fills the space.

artworks.title: Trompe l'Oeil: A Full House with Chips, $2 and $5 Bills
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite mounted on cardboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a two-dollar bill, playing cards, and poker chips. The two-dollar bill is at the center, with playing cards like the Ace of Hearts and King of Diamonds below. Surrounding them are red, blue, and white poker chips. The color scheme includes green, earth tones of the bill, reds and blacks of cards, and bright poker chip colors. The bill is placed at an angle over the cards, with chips scattered around it.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The composition includes a central figure on a cross, flanked by two others on crosses to the sides, set against a background with architectural elements like a church and buildings. In the foreground, figures are gathered at the base of the central cross, displaying gestures of lamentation and support. The scene is rendered in monochrome, highlighting the details and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.medium: gouache over black chalk on vellum
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing at the center. The person is standing with their right leg slightly forward and raises their right hand with two fingers extended while the left hand holds a red cross-like staff. The individual has medium-length, wavy brown hair and a beard, with a fair complexion. They are wrapped in a light, flowing cloth around the hips, leaving the chest and legs exposed. Surrounding them, there are two figures; one on the left side is seen collapsing with limbs bent, dressed in blue and green, and on the right, an armored figure is on one knee, resting their hands on a shield, with another, partially hidden figure in red beneath the armored one. The setting is bordered with an ornate gold frame and features an oval space at the top with a depiction of a bird and, at the bottom, the text "IN LUMINE TUO VIDEBIMUS LUMEN" inscribed within the frame. The overall background is minimal, emphasizing the figures and the elaborate frame.

artworks.title: Pink Roses in a Vase
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on vellum
artworks.description: This painting shows an arrangement of large pink roses in a tan vase set against a black background. The color palette includes various shades of pale pink for the flowers and buds, and green from the leaves and stems of the flowers. The vase is placed on a rectangular surface that appears to be a silver table or counter, showing a slight reflection of the flowers in streaks of pink and green. The black background has some gray streaks running though it that give the impression that it is wrinkled.

artworks.title: Standing Woman Holding a Scroll
artworks.medium: brush and wash with white gouache over black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dynamic pose. The face is outlined with serene features. The clothing is detailed with flowing lines and shading. The arm is extended sideways, holding something. The figure is against a plain background with a monochromatic palette and highlights showing light and shadow on the form.

artworks.title: The Headhunter and His Family
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a nude figure standing upright. The person faces to the side, with one arm extended upward, holding what appears to be a thin, elongated object. The other arm is bent so that the hand rests near the thigh, holding an object resembling a round helmet or a mask with a skull-like face on it. The figure's facial features are minimally detailed, showing a profile view with a slightly prominent nose and a bald head. Surrounding the figure is a series of abstract, sketchy lines that suggest a minimal, undefined background. There is no visible clothing or additional objects, and the setting appears to be a plain surface without distinct background scenery.

artworks.title: Cellule Auriculaire
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up view of a face in profile. The person's head and neck are captured within a circular frame. The person is shown in a side position, gazing downward. The facial features are softly sketched, with a prominent focus on the nose and the downward-closed eyes. The hair is dark and covers part of the forehead and ear. There appears to be an earring visible. The background is a textured, dark tonal surface with light and shadow creating a soft, dreamlike atmosphere around the figure.

artworks.title: Roger Marx
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's profile facing left. The man has a straight nose, long beard, and short hair. The background is plain, and the artwork is marked "1904" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Le noble peintre
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an art studio. On the left, a man is standing, facing forward. He is dressed in elaborate 17th-century clothing, including a feathered hat. In the center, a seated man holds painter's tools, looking at a canvas with a painting. To the right, a younger person holds a framed painting. The background features various artworks and detailed decorations, creating a luxurious atmosphere typical of a studio or gallery.

artworks.title: The Tomb of the Horatii and the Curatii at Albano
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient, crumbling structure with detailed stonework covered in vegetation. The technique used is detailed and linear, with precise pencil strokes creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray. In the distance are trees and another structure, while the sky above is depicted with light, wispy clouds.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia (recto) / Study of a Male Nude (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk; unrelated (?) touches of red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures interacting. The central figure is surrounded by others engaged in a discussion or activity. The lines are loose and sketch-like, with some figures in the background appearing more like outlines. The use of light brown washes gives the drawing a sepia tone, enhancing its vintage feel. The figures are clad in flowing garments, and the scene conveys a sense of narrative or drama. The composition suggests movement and interaction between the figures, with some leaning forward or gesticulating.

artworks.title: Diana and Apollo Slaughtering  the Children of Niobe
artworks.medium: red chalk, squared with black chalk and indented for transfer, on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures and gestures, executed in red chalk. The composition depicts entwined figures, some reclining, others gesturing upwards. A figure with a moon symbol on their headgear appears to be levitating from clouds. The composition conveys movement and emotion, suggesting themes of divine intervention or celestial phenomena.

artworks.title: An Elegantly Dressed Woman Struggling with a Lion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on blue paper with white heightening
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two abstract figures intertwined, drawn with dark ink on a blue paper background. The figures are composed of swirling lines and shapes, making it difficult to distinguish specific details like facial features or clothing. They appear to be in motion, interacting closely with each other. There are no discernible accessories or objects in the sketch. The background is plain blue paper, providing contrast to the dark ink lines of the drawing.

artworks.title: Saturn Wrestling with a Snake
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray inks with wash over chalk on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure in mid-air with a serpent. The art depicts a muscular, bearded, and winged figure engaged in dynamic motion with a serpent. The figure is entwined with the serpent, which wraps around the legs and is held in both hands. The wings are large and detailed, and the background consists of stylized clouds, creating a sense of depth and movement. The drawing is in tones of gray, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow on the figure.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls
artworks.medium: ambrotype
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wide vista of a waterfall from a slightly elevated point of view. The silhouette of a tree is on the left, with more trees in the background. Three silhouetted figures are standing close to us, looking at the waterfall. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, creating an antique feel. Mist rises from the waterfall, obscuring the view. The details are sharp with a softened effect due to the mist.
